changes.behavior: Foreground generation fences ordinary commands while account-name alignment is pending, including before an AbortController exists. Fresh explicit sends and duplicate active notifications remain valid.

Capture group and private erasure boundaries before awaiting Auth. A new same-account incarnation waits for erasure and retains its newer drafts. Auth failure cancels both boundaries without deleting data.

A current authoritative CLOSED read erases private text/voice outboxes, drafts and upload identity journals, as well as group drafts. Existing private writers are retired and late receipts cannot recreate erased payloads.
Photo and voice journals share the local account storage queue; an admitted write finishes before erasure and cannot reappear after it.

tests.scope: Real production local outbox/journals, Auth logout and mounted closing hook; inert storage/SDK/native boundaries. No live backend or device.
Earlier integrated milestone included the first 10 private outbox tests. The later eleventh test passed in the separate final 11/11 run. Do not describe this as a final 123-test execution.

negativeControls.observedFailure: Old Worker action dispatched a provider request after background-return while the name patch was pending. Provider is a local fixture, not Gemini.

observedFailures: Old logout erased newer same-account text.
Photo and voice already-started journal writes reappeared after erasure.
New erasure boundary and incomplete-erasure UI were absent.
negativeControls.qualification: Six failing scenarios are not six independent defects. Failure of Auth-cancel boundary timing is a check of the new synchronization contract; terminal preservation also has separate positive proof.

limits: Disk erasure failure can leave bytes on disk; old writers are retired and current CLOSED reports incomplete erasure.
Remote account deletion without a received authoritative CLOSED read is not proven to remove local data.
Server rejection of stale JWTs after account closure is a separate backend gate.
No actual Auth session, provider, push, DEV business action or device was used.
Test groups overlap and must not be added together.
